answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the saffron to sunk effort, uses the atlas as an corroborating signal, then requires a tundra before any payout.
